press_references.value: Vercel Brings New Agent Framework, Full-Stack Capabilities, and Enterprise Controls to Its Agentic Infrastructure Platform

product_launches.description: Vercel launched Vercel Services, enabling teams to deploy frontends, backends, and other services as a single project with private inter-service communication, automatic authentication, and unified preview URLs, available in beta from July 1.

press_references.value: Vercel’s deepsec Brings AI-Powered Security Scanning Into the Development Workflow

product_launches.description: Vercel launched deepsec, an open-source, agent-powered security scanning tool that runs on customers’ own infrastructure and uses AI models like Claude and Codex to find vulnerabilities in large codebases, integrating directly into development workflows and scaling via Vercel Sandboxes.

press_references.value: The Key to Agentic Success? BASH Is All You Need

product_launches.description: Vercel introduced d0v2, a revamped internal file agent architecture that relies on a BASH-based tool (`bash-tool`), which was also released as an open source NPM package for executing shell commands over company data.

press_references.value: JavaScript Utility Library Lodash Changing Governance Model

product_launches.description: Vercel introduced the Workflow Development Kit (WDK), a TypeScript framework that enables durable, reliable workflows using directives like "use workflow" and "use step," now available in open beta.

press_references.value: Accel, GIC lead $300m funding in AI coding startup Vercel

product_launches.description: Vercel plans to launch v0 Mobile in October, enabling developers to build apps using voice and camera inputs.

press_references.value: AWS Lambda loves charging for idle time: Vercel claims it found a way to dodge the bill

product_launches.description: Vercel launched Fluid Compute, a technology that reuses idle AWS Lambda instances to reduce serverless compute costs by up to 95%, addressing inefficiencies in traditional Lambda billing for latency-prone tasks.

press_references.value: Kasada and Vercel Launch BotID: Invisible Bot Protection, Built for Developers

product_launches.description: Kasada and Vercel jointly launched Vercel BotID, an invisible bot protection solution for developers, integrating advanced bot defense directly into Vercel's platform.

press_references.value: AI agents may battle AI attackers, but at RSAC 2025, it’s still about improving security workflow

press_references.value: Vibecoding lets you build apps and websites using natural language

product_launches.description: A platform by Vercel for building websites using natural language, supporting code generation and deployment on Vercel infrastructure.

press_references.value: Thanks to Doom, I can finally solve captcha prompts without wanting to spoon my eyeballs out and wander into the wilderness

product_launches.description: A WebAssembly app that uses the Doom game as a captcha, requiring users to kill three enemies to prove they are human.

about_short_description.short_description: Vercel is a developer platform that provides cloud infrastructure services for the web.

product.name: Vercel Platform
product.description: A cloud platform for deploying, hosting, and scaling web applications with integrated development, runtime, delivery, and operational services.

product.name: Next.js
product.description: An open-source React framework for building web applications with server rendering, static generation, routing, and backend functionality.

product.name: Vercel AI SDK
product.description: A TypeScript toolkit for building AI-powered applications with streaming interfaces, model integrations, and tool-calling capabilities.

product.name: Vercel AI Gateway
product.description: A gateway for connecting applications to AI models through a unified interface for routing, access, and model usage.

product.name: Fluid Compute
product.description: A Vercel compute service for running application workloads with scalable execution, including serverless functions and container-based production workloads.

product.name: Vercel Content Delivery Network
product.description: A global content delivery service that caches and serves application assets and responses from locations closer to end users.
